sport.en: Doing sport regularly makes us healthier and happier.
sport.cn: 经常运动让我们更健康快乐。

football.en: He has played football since he was four years old.
football.cn: 他从四岁就开始踢足球。

basketball.en: Our basketball team practises every Tuesday and Thursday.
basketball.cn: 我们篮球队每周二周四训练。

swimming.en: Swimming is one of the best whole-body exercises.
swimming.cn: 游泳是最好的全身运动之一。

running.en: I go running for thirty minutes every morning.
running.cn: 我每天早上跑步三十分钟。

match.en: Our team won the match three goals to one.
match.cn: 我们队 3 比 1 赢得了比赛。

champion.en: She became the youngest champion in school history.
champion.cn: 她成为学校历史上最年轻的冠军。

energy.en: Eating well gives us the energy to play hard.
energy.cn: 吃得好让我们有能量去尽情运动。
